title: When K-pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind the Scenes of ae-aespa's Whiplash Production Story Revealed!
description:
The 3D creative process behind K-pop stages is unveiled for the first time!

In this video, we interview 3D designers Jinbeom and Jon, who created the digital costumes in ae-aespa's "Whiplash" using Marvelous Designer and CLO3D@CLO's official account, transforming creative imagination into stunning visual impact!

Marvelous Designer and CLO3D belong to the same ecosystem, providing a seamless 3D design experience. This cross-platform collaboration is breaking down the boundaries between fashion, technology, and entertainment, redefining the future of 3D creation.

summary: ```markdown # When K-pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind the Scenes of ae-aespa's "Whiplash" Production Story Revealed! ## Introduction Hello, I'm Park Jin-beom, and I work on visual creative projects under the name TAGIREN. Recently, I collaborated on aespa's "We Flash" album, focusing on the character artwork for i-aespa. Hi, I'm Yon Sanchez, a digital fashion creator and 3D artist. My work specializes in creating realistic and visually appealing clothing. I worked with Jin-beom on the We Flash Universe project. ## The Beginning of Collaboration Two years ago, while preparing for an online lecture, I wanted to explain to students how to create clothes and utilize existing asset clothing. At that time, I was searching for assets to use. Yon had a plethora of professionally and systematically produced clothes, so I aimed to explain how to customize them to the students. That's when I reached out to Yon, which marked the beginning of our friendship. I looked at Jin-beom's Instagram and thought, "Okay, this person knows what she's doing. I love her style. I want to work with her." ## Character Artwork and Design Process The character artwork for i-aespa was uploaded to my social media by SM Entertainment. I saw the previous character artwork and was thankful when Jin-beom contacted me about collaborating on the artwork. I felt it was a great opportunity to redesign the character and create the outfit. I had a lot of fun working on it, and it was a meaningful project for both of us. During that time, I was in touch with Yon and recognized his excellent skills. I asked him to collaborate with me on the outfit for i-aespa. Jin-beom sent me a direct message proposing the collaboration, and without hesitation, I agreed. ## Fluid Collaboration and Communication Our connection was very natural and collaborative. Working together has been fluid; we actively share connections, provide mutual feedback, and support each other significantly throughout the project. From the outset, the project had a clear direction. The process was seamless; I quickly developed the basic structure and then added the intricate details. Yon and I had collaborated several times before, and because of our previous experiences, we were able to move forward quickly with smooth communication. ## Tools and Technologies Used Thanks to the collaboration between Clou and Marvellous Designer, our workflow was faster and more efficient. Utilizing Marvellous Designer allowed us to dedicate more time to concepts and detail level, enabling us to create high-quality artwork. The compatibility of the files made it easier to review our work. I have been fortunate to work with other K-pop artists since the IESPA "Reflash Universe" project. ## Future Aspirations I aspire to have a career in both the game industry and the fashion or entertainment sectors, but my ultimate goal is to become a 3D artist across various industries, especially as a 3D character artist. Working on the IESPA project opened many doors for me, leading to opportunities with fashion brands, the automotive industry, and various projects where I can continue learning. One of my dreams is to create my own fashion brand. However, it's a long-term aspiration, so I'm not in a rush. I need to keep learning, exploring, meeting people, and staying informed about trends. ## Conclusion Clou is an essential part of my daily work. It enables me to experiment digitally with various forms. I am excited to showcase my new projects. Currently, I primarily work with Marvellous Designer and appreciate the excellent compatibility between Clou and Marvellous Designer software. The tools provided by Marvellous Designer are crucial to achieving my goals, and I plan to continue using them to advance my career. ```
